Payout of 6 August is short ₹4,354.90.
The bank credited ₹2,47,837.85 against an expected ₹2,52,192.75. 16 orders sit in this payout. This is consistent with refund rfnd_000011 of ₹4,354.90, issued 18 July against payment pay_000091. Refunds are deducted from the cycle that processes them, not the cycle of the original sale, so a payout can be reduced by a refund against a much earlier purchase.
Suggested action: verify rfnd_000011 in the refund report and confirm it was deducted from this payout. The amounts match, which is not proof of cause -- rfnd_000011 is booked to another cycle, so the link is not confirmed.
